routes.title: About StimaAlert — How the Outage Map Works
routes.description: How StimaAlert collects and verifies estate outage reports, what the Telegram bot sends you, and answers to common questions about the map and your data.

faq.question: Where does StimaAlert's outage data come from?
faq.answer: From residents. Anyone can report an outage, and other people in the same estate confirm it. A report becomes ACTIVE once neighbours back it up. There is no scraping and no server-side pinging.

faq.question: Do I need an account to use StimaAlert?
faq.answer: No. The map is public and anonymous. The Telegram bot only stores your chat id so it can message you about the estates you follow.

faq.question: How quickly will I hear that power is back?
faq.answer: When an outage is resolved, everyone following that estate gets a Telegram message. The bot also asks followers whether power has returned about two hours after an outage is reported.
